params.name: page_size
params.description: (OPTIONAL) Number of responses per page. By default, it has a value of 25 and must be within a range of [25 - 100]

items.docs:
Provides the data of the available performance evaluations.
Each performance evaluation has the following attributes:
- id: Unique Id of the performance evaluation
- name: name of performance evaluation
- participants: number of participants added to performance evaluation
- status: performance evaluation status
- start_date: performance evaluation start date
- end_date: performance evaluation end date
- global_progress: percentage of completed forms 
- stages: stages set for performance evaluat

info.name: Show the results of the Competency from a performance evaluation

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the performance evaluation to be queried

params.name: page_size
params.description: (Optional) Number of responses per page. By default it has a value of 25 and must be within a range of [25 - 100]

items.docs:
Displays the results related to the Competency from the queried performance evaluation.
A result of Competency from a performance evaluation has the following attributes:
- evaluation_id: Unique ID of the performance evaluation
- evaluation_status: Status of the evaluated employee
- evaluated_name: Name of the evaluated employee
- evaluated_rut: RUT of the evaluated employee
evaluated_document_number: Document Number of the evaluated employee
evaluated_document_type: Type of Document of the eval
